title: DependencyRegistry
description: Per-surface dependency registry for the S-84 refresh architecture

backing_generator.description: Path to backing Python script, or null for agent-executed surfaces

backing_skill.description: Skill ID(s) that generate this surface (e.g. 'S-62 (batch-reference)')

fingerprints_required.description: List of input fingerprint field names that apply to this surface

template_paths.description: Paths to Hugo theme template directories for this surface

config_path.description: Path to Hugo config file for this subdomain

content_root.description: Content root path template (may contain {family} and {platform} placeholders)

expected_output_source.description: How expected output paths are derived for reconciliation

regeneration_triggers.description: Input fingerprint names that trigger full regeneration when changed

reconciliation_triggers.description: Conditions that trigger output reconciliation check

supports_targeted_run.description: Whether this surface can be refreshed independently without a full S-84 run

status.description: Operational status: supported=script-backed, validate_only=agent-executed, unsupported=no generator
